easy.def: To do something fun for a special day.
examples: We celebrate my birthday with cake.
We celebrate the new year with a party.
Let's celebrate! You lost a tooth!

more.def: To do something special or fun to mark a happy day or event.
examples: The team celebrated their win with a pizza party.
Many families celebrate holidays with special meals.
The town celebrated the opening of the new bridge.
That is certainly a big dog.
That is certainly the biggest pumpkin I have ever seen.
I will certainly be there on time.
It was certainly a surprise to see snow in May.
